correctness.rationale: Formal decomposition of marked noncrossing partitions into initial blocks and outer irreducibles is exact. Its two derivatives give C_u=t^r(1-t)/(1-2t), F_s=zC^3, and F_su=t^r(1+t)/(1-2t). Formal residue change z=t(1-t) yields exact binomial coefficients M and M(3n-2r)/n. Catalan coefficients yield E[R]=3n/(n+2). Positivity of M and sign of 3n-r(n+2) proves the complete finite sign theorem, while factorial-ratio asymptotics handle each fixed r. Independent RGS enumeration through n=9 passed all 263 exact/bounded checks in verify.py; no infinite claim rests on it.

value.rationale: Outer irreducible-component count and size-resolved block frequencies are separately natural statistics in random noncrossing partitions. Li explicitly identifies their joint size-profile as a motivated research direction. The exact affine size-biased outer-count regression, one isolated cancellation at n=4,r=2, strict all-size sign classification, and the r=3 borderline scaling give structural dependence information not obtainable from merely displaying either marginal law. The assessed theorem is an exact cross moment, not a claim to solve the full joint distribution.
